top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Discipline - Teaches Acceptable Behavior and Self-control (26 TAC §746.2803(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained, it was determined the operations discipline methods does not teach acceptable behavior and self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were not able to intervene when a child was able to leave the playground and run into the parking lot.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection a caregiver was observed to be alone with a group of children when the conditions of their background check stated that they cannot be alone with a child or group of children.
